text_block_list.text:
I remember, a long time ago, a friend
and I used
to play pretend cafe. My
friend played the cafe's
barista.
Whereas, I...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I meander aimlessly, stuck trying to put

something together for the next training
regimen,
when...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Barista
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, you look rather lost in thought.
How about
a cup of coffee at my cafe?
I've just opened up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a look at the cafe before me.
There's
something about the rustic
exterior that draws me
in...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Welcome. I think... you will be our last

customer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'll pour you... a cup of coffee.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Here you are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The execution is perfect. My attention is
drawn to
its charming expression. And...
into the center of
its round eyes...
choice_data_list: おお、猫のラテアートだな
おお、猫のラテアートだね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I... become sucked in...
HEY, wake up already!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're conscious... Your eyes look fine.

Everything's normal. Just as I thought.
We got
here right before the nosedive.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We're investigating the "illogical" cafe!
Shakur
couldn't get it off her mind. This
place is
wonderful, don't you think?
choice_data_list: ど、どうしたんだいきなり……？
ど、どうしたのいきなり……？
choice_data_list_en: Wh-What's with you all of a sudden...?
Wh-What's with you all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Cafe, there's no foolin' me. I know this is
all your
doing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The trigger is the coffee, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The latte art serves as a visual
distraction as you
alter our state of
consciousness. In other words,
it's
hypnosis.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But what I can't figure out is... how you

hypnotized us before serving the latte
art.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Doesn't make sense no matter
how you
slice it.
choice_data_list_en: Before... looking at the latte art...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You were drawn to this cafe the moment
you saw
it, right? The same thing
happened to us, and
everyone else
who's visited this place.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So, you walk inside and who's behind
the bar?
None other than Cafe. Were
you surprised?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right. One look from the outside and I
did a feel
a strong pull inviting me in.
But I didn't find it
strange that
Manhattan Cafe was inside.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
My suspicions brought me back here.
And just as I
arrived, there you were
moseying your way inside.
choice_data_list: 言われてみると、不自然だな……
言われてみると、不自然だね……
choice_data_list_en: Now that you mention it, that does seem unnatural...
Now that you mention it, that does seem strange...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The question is... what is it that altered
your
consciousness from the start?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Cafe. It's time to come clean. What did
you do?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...This cafe appears... to those who seek
it. I
only... pour this coffee... with
passion.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I don't understand it... myself. But I
don't... need
to. This is fine... the way it
is.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose... it's about time to finish up,

however.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe lifts the coffee mug in
her hand
and...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-y-you shouldn't do that, Cafe! Coffee
mugs
aren't meant to be—Hwah! Th-the
sun!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It was nice... getting to play pretend
cafe after all
this time. But now...
playtime is over. Thank you...
for acting
as one of the staff.

text_block_list.name: Black Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's enough for now. I'm all out of
coffee
beans.

text_block_list.name: Black Cat
text_block_list.text: Meooow.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Sure. We can do this again once I get a
hold of
some new beans. I enjoyed
myself. It brought
back memories.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Someday... I want to brew a delicious,
comforting
cup of coffee. Just like my
father... did for his
customers.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but next time... don't bring in any
customers
by force.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I know that you approached everyone.
First you
were a child, then a
fishmonger...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-huh? I don't remember coming here...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh... oh! That's right!
choice_data_list_en: I think it was at a café...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Cafe was helping out at a cafe, so we
dropped by
to taste her brew!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That's right. And the coffee
wasn't half
bad.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hey, it's nearly curfew. I'll catch
you around.
Not in the mood to hear an
earful for being late.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, Shakur! W-wait for meee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I still feel lightheaded. And actually... I
have a
strange feeling that maybe,
someone's watching
me.

...I'm looking forward to your next visit. I
will have
a special brew ready... just for
you.
choice_data_list: 気のせいか……。俺も学園に戻ろう……
気のせいか……。私も学園に戻ろう……
choice_data_list_en: Just my imagination, huh... I should head back to the academy too...
Just my imagination, huh... I should head back to the academy too...

text_block_list.text:
As I watch the three of them return to
the
academy, I whisper the words that
remind me of
her.

text_block_list.name: Black Cat
text_block_list.text: And scratch my ear with my hind leg.
